turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Hannah. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, water is coming through my ceiling and I'm really worried about the damage.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm really sorry you're going through this, I can imagine how worrying that is. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. I can see your policy here, it's comprehensive cover and it's due for renewal next month. Just to check I'm speaking to the right person, can I take your date of birth and postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: 14 August 1993, TM1 7QF.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's fine.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've had a water leak at home and you'd like to make a claim. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you tell me exactly what happened, and when it happened?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It started about an hour ago. The pipe under the kitchen sink burst and water's gone across the whole floor.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. Was anyone injured, and how extensive is the damage?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Everyone's safe, but the floor and the bottom of the cabinets are soaked and some electrics are close by.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And can you confirm the address of the property?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 14 Larch Avenue.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Honestly, this is ridiculous. Can I speak to a manager?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand, and I'm sorry for the frustration. I can arrange for a supervisor to call you back within 24 hours, or log a formal complaint. Which would you prefer?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: A supervisor callback, please.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Surely you can approve the repair costs right now though?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Look, as I already said, it's all in the terms and conditions. I don't know how else to explain it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. Because it's an emergency you can arrange an urgent repair yourself, up to $500, without needing our approval first. Just keep every receipt.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. I've logged your claim under reference CLM-72224, and the home claims team will contact you about the repairs.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've taken the details of your claim and passed it to the home claims team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
